topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing, practical context, and learning objectives for the lecture.

topics.label: Tumor virology, proto-oncogenes, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the historical discovery of transforming viruses and cellular proto-oncogenes alongside the experimental assays used to measure cellular transformation.

topics.label: Functional classification of cancer genes and mutation mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the functional definitions of oncogenic and tumor-suppressive mutations and the molecular mechanisms that determine their dominant or recessive effects.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how distinct failures in DNA repair, replication fidelity, and mitotic chromosome segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the multi-step accumulation of mutations during tumor evolution and examine how inherited genetic defects influence cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing remarks, recommended reading, and a preview of the next session.
